title: Calendar Capacity Contract
summary: Resolve shifts, holidays, work-center capacity and business-time calculations without taking workforce product ownership.

criteria: The contract resolves one versioned calendar from a shift pattern, a holiday set, a planned downtime set and a work-center capacity declaration, rather than leaving each consumer to assemble its own.
business-time is the primitive the platform actually needs: a question such as X business days later is answered from the resolved calendar instead of from wall-clock arithmetic.
A resolve call is deterministic for a given calendar version, so an APS input and a promise date computed at different moments agree when they name the same version.
timezone and daylight saving transitions are part of the declaration, so a shift that crosses a transition boundary is neither duplicated nor lost.
overlapping calendar precedence is declared explicitly: when a site, a work-center and a tenant calendar disagree, the resolution order is fixed rather than emergent.
Evaluation is delegated: computation graph ownership stays with computation-runtime-contract, and this contract supplies calendar semantics rather than an execution engine.
workforce product ownership is excluded and shift roster and staffing assignment are excluded; the kernel primitive describes time and capacity, not people management.

risks.desc: Resolving against an implicit current calendar would make a promise date irreproducible: the same query would return different answers before and after a holiday was added.
risks.mitigation: Require an explicit calendar version on every resolve, keep versions append-only and prove that adding a holiday does not retroactively move an existing promise.

risks.desc: A shift crossing a daylight saving transition can be silently duplicated or dropped, which shifts every downstream capacity and delivery figure by an hour without any error.
risks.mitigation: Declare timezone per calendar, model both transition directions explicitly and prove no duplication or loss with dedicated negatives.

risks.desc: If a site, work-center and tenant calendar can disagree without a declared precedence, the answer depends on evaluation order and becomes unstable across callers.
risks.mitigation: Declare overlapping calendar precedence explicitly and prove deterministic resolution under a three-way disagreement.

risks.desc: A calendar and capacity primitive is easily misread as owning workforce management, shift rostering, sequencing or jurisdiction resolution.
risks.mitigation: Keep all exclusions explicit in every phase, take a locale-driven holiday set as input, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The contract sağlar one versioned calendar resolved from a shift pattern, a holiday set, a planned downtime set and a work-center capacity declaration.
Girdi is a calendar version plus a starting instant and a duration expressed in business terms; çıktı is a resolved instant, an available capacity figure or a refusal.
business-time answers X business days later from the resolved calendar rather than from wall-clock arithmetic, which is what an APS input and a promise date both require.

timezone and daylight saving handling and overlapping calendar precedence are declared, so a shift crossing a transition is neither duplicated nor lost and a three-way disagreement resolves deterministically.

Kapsam sınırı gereği workforce product ownership is excluded, shift roster and staffing assignment are excluded, scheduling and sequencing execution are excluded, jurisdiction resolution is excluded and bitemporal as-of restatement is excluded.

Kapsa: one versioned calendar from shifts, holidays, downtime and work-center capacity, business-time resolution, timezone and daylight saving handling, declared precedence. Exclude workforce ownership, rostering, sequencing, jurisdiction resolution and as-of restatement. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: A calendar decides delivery commitments and available capacity, so declaring or publishing a calendar version is a privileged action gated by explicit yetki rather than open to any consumer.
tenant izolasyon holds: a holiday or planned downtime declared by one tenant never shortens another tenant's business-time result, and a cross-tenant calendar read is denied.
A published calendar version is immutable, so a promise date stays defensible; a change creates a new version and leaves a denetim izi naming the operator.
Erişim is read-mostly: resolving business-time requires no write capability, which keeps the declaration surface small and reviewable.
A work-center capacity figure is exposed only to callers already authorized for that site, so the calendar never becomes a side channel for operational intelligence.
security.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/security: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
security.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract security kapsamı. Kapsa: privileged declaration and publication, tenant-isolated holidays and downtime, immutable versions with audit, read-mostly resolution, site-scoped capacity exposure. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one tipli calendar katman so shift, holiday, downtime and capacity inputs cannot develop divergent resolution rules.
business-time resolution stays a pure function with low karmaşıklık, testable from a fixed calendar version without a scheduler, and declaration stays separated from execution.
Ölü kod and speculative per-industry calendar variants are refused, the short-code bütçe is respected, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: En az ayrıcalık separates declaring a calendar, publishing a version and resolving business-time, so a planning consumer never holds calendar authority.
The accepted timezone and shift-pattern vocabulary is an allowlist, so an unrecognised zone or pattern is refused rather than silently normalised.
The declaration yüzey stays kapalı: a calendar composes only registered shift patterns, holiday sets and downtime windows, with no free expression evaluation.
Calendar publication is rate-bounded per tenant, so a rapid churn of versions cannot be used to obscure a change that moves committed delivery dates.
securityOptimization.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: separated declare, publish and resolve privileges, allowlisted timezones and shift patterns, closed declaration surface, bounded publication rate. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for a single business-time resolve and a separate budget for a bulk capacity query over a planning horizon; no measurement is claimed here.
A resolved calendar version is read through a bounded önbellek keyed by version and scope, which is safe precisely because published versions are immutable.
Bulk planning queries must avoid N+1 access: a horizon is resolved in one pass rather than one resolve call per day or per work-center.
performance.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budgets for single resolve and bulk horizon queries, version-keyed cache justified by immutability, single-pass horizon resolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client reads a business-time result together with the calendar version that produced it; a cihaz may not compute business days from its own local clock.
An offline client shows the last synchronised calendar version as stale and refuses to promise a date, since a promise requires a live version reference.
No mobile-only shift or holiday source is introduced here; rendering a calendar stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: result plus calendar version on mobile, no device-side business-day arithmetic, stale offline display without promising dates, no mobile-only calendar source. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future calendar surface must convey a non-working day, a planned downtime and a capacity shortfall through text and shape rather than colour alone, at the WCAG AAA kontrast threshold with a visible odak ring.
A resolved date must be announced with its timezone and calendar version through an aria description, so a klavye-only or screen-reader user is never given a bare date.
This contract defines calendar semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: non-colour-only conveyance of non-working days, downtime and shortfalls at AAA contrast, timezone and version announced with the date, keyboard-first operation, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; the hosting topology and container dağıtım of any calendar service remain human-developer work behind ops-plane authority.
Publishing a new calendar version is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a redeploy; rollback pins consumers back to the previous version.
Reverting this calendar shard changes the planning contract and the projections derived from it, never a committed delivery date, so runtimeDataImpact stays none and NO-GO remains in force.
deployment.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, hosting owned by the ops plane, data-level version publish without redeploy, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A published calendar version olay may be announced so planning consumers repin, but this contract never reschedules work or issues a business action on its own.
A reaction chain raised from a publication olay stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a calendar change cannot cascade into an unbounded replanning storm.
Re-delivering the same publication olay must be idempoten, and changing a holiday set or a precedence order always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: publication events without rescheduling, depth-bounded reaction chains, idempotent replay and approval-gated holiday and precedence changes. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay yasak.
AI cannot publish a calendar version, cannot declare a holiday or downtime and cannot change a precedence order; each of those needs insan onayı with a step-up review.

Any externally supplied calendar feed reaching the lane as sub_prompt is güvenilmez, the kill-switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 sınır or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from publishing versions, declaring holidays or changing precedence, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases resolve a calendar from a shift pattern, a holiday set and a planned downtime set and assert an X business days later result, as birim and entegrasyon matrices.
Planned negatif cases prove a resolve without an explicit calendar version is refused rather than answered against an implicit current calendar.
Planned negatif cases prove a shift crossing a daylight saving transition is neither duplicated nor dropped and that a timezone-naive input is refused.
Planned negatif cases prove overlapping calendar precedence resolves deterministically under a site, work-center and tenant disagreement, and that tenant isolation holds.
Calendar results are recordable only from a human-approved run that truly executed, so the planned matrices here are never counted as passing tests.
testing.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: business-time positives from a resolved calendar, missing-version negatives, daylight saving and timezone negatives, precedence and tenant isolation negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A08 software and data integrity failures is the defining axis: immutable calendar versions are what stop a committed delivery date from being retroactively redefined.
OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by separating calendar declaration authority from resolution access and by scoping capacity figures to authorized sites.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by refusing an implicit current calendar, so no caller can obtain a result that cannot be reproduced later.
Girdi doğrulama applies to every declaration: timezone, shift pattern, holiday set and precedence order are validated against allowlists, and each publication leaves a denetim izi.
owasp.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A08 via immutable versions, A01 via separated declaration authority and site-scoped capacity, A04 via refusing implicit calendars, allowlist validation with audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-calendar-capacity with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-calendar-capacity] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so resolving a calendar touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a publication is announced as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor computation-runtime-contract ends 2028-04-30, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.

Bağımlılık yönü stays exactly computation-runtime-contract; jurisdiction resolution is excluded and jurisdiction-resolution-contract is not a dependency, and the parent-only k-archetype-computation edge and the parent related list are not inherited.
Scope stays inside the calendar sözleşme: workforce product ownership, shift roster and staffing assignment, scheduling and sequencing execution and bitemporal as-of restatement all stay outside.
integration.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-calendar-capacity to the same provider, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn without jurisdiction, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir business-time and capacity through this contract and may not implement its own business-day arithmetic or reach a doğrudan tablo for shift rows.
A consumer must carry the calendar version with any stored promise date, so a later audit can tell which calendar produced the commitment.
Owning workforce management, the shift roster and the sequencing engine belongs elsewhere; this sözleşme resolves time and capacity and never assigns people or orders work.
moduleUsage.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: contract-mediated business-time consumption without local arithmetic or direct table reads, calendar version carried with promise dates, externally owned workforce, rostering and sequencing. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A shift pattern combined with a small work-center can identify individuals indirectly, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir for any operator identity carried in a downtime record.
Published calendar versions have their own saklama süresi, longer than the promises they produced, because a delivery commitment is only defensible while the calendar behind it is still readable.
Calendar versions are retained append-only so a past promise stays reproducible, and declarations evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: indirect PII through small work-center shift patterns with KVKK/GDPR classification and DSAR path, calendar retention longer than the promises, append-only versions and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrik set includes resolve latency, bulk horizon query latency, refusal rate by cause and the share of consumers pinned to a superseded calendar version, on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the calendar version, scope and timezone; capacity figures and operator identities are redacted and never become metric labels.

Alarm coverage includes a refusal spike after a calendar publication, a surge of consumers stuck on a superseded version and a precedence conflict rate above its bound; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: resolve and horizon latency SLIs, refusal-cause metrics, redacted version-scoped traces, superseded-version and precedence-conflict alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The dominant failure mode is an unresolvable calendar version; the contract refuses the request rather than falling back to a wall-clock approximation that would silently move a promise.
Resolution is idempoten by construction: the same calendar version, starting instant and duration yield the same result, so a retry with bounded backoff changes nothing.
A repeatedly failing bulk horizon query is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than blocking the planning queue, and a circuit breaker protects the shared resolution path.
reliability.notes: calendar-capacity-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Calendar Capacity Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: refusal instead of wall-clock fallback, idempotent resolution with bounded retry, dead-letter routing without head-of-line blocking and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
